identity.title: Time-reproduction (Time2Dist) — Exp2
identity.summary: Multi-session time-reproduction paradigm. Participants observe a moving stimulus, an occlusion period of variable duration, and reproduce the perceived duration via a key-press or click response. Exp2 differs from Exp1 in the stimulus distribution (between-subject) and adds a per-trial confidence rating.
identity.research_question: Whether prior shape of the duration distribution (uniform vs. bimodal) systematically biases temporal reproduction across days, and whether confidence tracks bias magnitude.

hierarchy.one_liner: session: par.day 1..5 (within_subject); block: for iR=1:nBlocks (Day1=10 train, Day2-5=12 test); trial: for iT=1:nT (40); total ≈ 5 × ~11 × 40 = 2200

phases.label: uniform-prior training
phases.description: 10 blocks of uniform-prior training; feedback after every trial.

phases.label: test (between-subject dist)
phases.description: 12 blocks; dist (A or B) assigned per-subject via mod(subjNum,2).

factors.name: dist
factors.description: Between-subject distribution of stimulus durations. Assigned via mod(subjNum, 2).

factors.name: day
factors.description: Session day. Day 1 = training-only, Day 2-5 = test.

factors.name: stim_duration
factors.description: Per-trial target stimulus duration drawn from dist on each trial.

conditions.label: training
conditions.description: Uniform-prior training on Day 1, all subjects.

design_matrix_summary: Between-subject: dist ∈ {A, B} assigned by mod(subjNum, 2). Within-subject longitudinal: day 1..5 (training day 1, test days 2-5).

parameters.name: tprecue
parameters.description: Pre-cue interval before the moving stimulus appears.

saved_variables.name: Stm
saved_variables.description: Target stimulus duration on each trial.

figure_outputs.what: Per-day scatter of reproduction vs. target duration with regression line.

storage.naming_convention: <subID>_day<N>.mat for session logs; results_<subID>_day<N>_block<iR>.mat for per-block backups.

randomization.description: Per-subject schedule generated at recruitment and saved into trial_schedule.mat; replayed deterministically.

score.notes: Strong seed + randomization scheme; no environment capture file. Adding a setup_environment.m documenting PTB build + MATLAB version would bring env_capture to partial.

counterbalancing.scheme: Between-subject dist assigned by mod(subjNum, 2); balanced across recruited cohort.

sample_size_justification.evidence: docs/01_experiment_design.md §5 cites N=20 per dist (precedent Jazayeri & Shadlen 2010)

blinding.note: Within-subject longitudinal estimation paradigm; blinding not meaningful.

rules_found: RT cutoff: Est outside [0.1, 3.0] sec → trial excluded
Block accuracy < 30% → block flagged in QC report

score.notes: Strong on counterbalancing + precedent-based N + exclusion rules. -10 for no pre-registration; -7 for sample-size being precedent rather than power-analysis.
